test_cases.title: GPS App Executes at 5 Hz on Static Schedule
test_cases.setup: Instantiate gps_app with stubbed gps_lib, stubbed nmea_lib, and a stubbed bus broker. Drive the static TDM scheduler with simulated time.
procedure: Initialize gps_app with the stubbed dependencies and register it on the static schedule.
Record the scheduler tick at the start of the test as T0.
Advance simulated time forward by 1.000 seconds while servicing the scheduler.
Count the number of times the gps_app execute hook was invoked between T0 and T0+1.000s.
Compare the invocation count against the expected 5 Hz cadence.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The gps_app execute hook is invoked exactly 5 times within the 1.000-second window, with inter-invocation interval of 200 ms +/- scheduler tolerance.

test_cases.title: GPS App Reads NMEA Bytes from gps_lib Each Tick
test_cases.setup: Instantiate gps_app with a stubbed gps_lib that records every read API call and returns canned NMEA bytes. Stub nmea_lib and bus broker.
procedure: Initialize gps_app with the stubbed gps_lib.
Reset the gps_lib stub read-call counter to zero.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook N=10 times via the scheduler.
Read the gps_lib stub read-call counter.
Compare the counter to N.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The gps_lib stub records exactly N read API invocations after N gps_app execute hook invocations.

test_cases.title: GPS App Forwards Raw Bytes to nmea_lib for Parsing
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib delivers a known NMEA byte buffer. Stubbed nmea_lib captures every parse API invocation and the bytes passed to it.
procedure: Configure the gps_lib stub to return a fixed NMEA buffer 'BUF' on its read API.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Inspect the nmea_lib stub for parse-API invocations.
Compare the bytes delivered to nmea_lib against BUF.
Inspect the gps_app source to confirm no in-app NMEA tokenization, checksum logic, or field extraction is performed outside nmea_lib.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: nmea_lib parse API is invoked with bytes equal to BUF, and gps_app source contains no inline NMEA parsing logic.

test_cases.title: GPS App Publishes Structured Fix on Successful Parse
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib supplies a valid NMEA buffer. Stubbed nmea_lib returns a successful parse with a known GPS fix structure. Stubbed bus broker captures all publish calls.
procedure: Configure nmea_lib stub to return success with a known fix {lat=L, lon=G, alt=A, fix_quality=1}.
Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Read all publish calls captured by the bus broker stub.
Identify the structured GPS fix message and compare its fields {lat, lon, alt, fix_quality} against {L, G, A, 1}.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Exactly one structured GPS fix message is published on the bus per successful parse, with fields equal to {L, G, A, 1}.

test_cases.title: GPS App Does Not Publish Fix on Parse Failure
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib supplies a buffer. Stubbed nmea_lib returns parse failure. Stubbed bus broker captures all publish calls.
procedure: Configure nmea_lib stub to return a parse-failure status for the next invocation.
Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Inspect the bus broker capture buffer for any structured GPS fix messages on the fix topic.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Zero structured GPS fix messages are published on the fix topic when nmea_lib reports a parse failure.

test_cases.title: GPS App Publishes Raw NMEA Bytes Verbatim on Bus
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib delivers a known raw NMEA buffer 'RAW' including CRLF. Stubbed bus broker captures all publish calls. nmea_lib stub returns success.
procedure: Configure the gps_lib stub to return RAW on its read API.
Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Locate the raw-NMEA bus publication in the capture buffer.
Perform a byte-by-byte comparison between the published payload and RAW.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The raw NMEA bus publication payload matches RAW byte-for-byte with no characters added, removed, or modified.

test_cases.title: GPS App Publishes Health Status Every Tick
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib returns success. Stubbed nmea_lib returns success. Stubbed bus broker captures all publish calls and tags them with their topic.
procedure: Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook N=10 times.
Filter the captured publish calls to the gps health topic.
Count the number of health publications captured.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The bus broker captures exactly N health publications on the gps health topic after N gps_app execute invocations.

test_cases.title: GPS App Reports Healthy When gps_lib Read Succeeds
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib returns success on every read. Stubbed nmea_lib returns success. Stubbed bus broker captures health publications.
procedure: Configure gps_lib stub to return JUNO_STATUS_SUCCESS for all reads.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Locate the gps health publication captured by the bus broker.
Inspect the health field of the captured payload.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The captured gps health publication reports the healthy state when gps_lib read returns success.

test_cases.title: GPS App Reports Unhealthy When gps_lib Read Fails
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib returns a failure status on read. Stubbed bus broker captures health publications.
procedure: Configure gps_lib stub to return a non-success JUNO_STATUS_T on its next read.
Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Locate the gps health publication captured by the bus broker.
Inspect the health field of the captured payload.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The captured gps health publication reports the unhealthy state when gps_lib read returns a failure status.

test_cases.title: GPS App Skips Fix Publication When Read Fails
test_cases.setup: Stubbed gps_lib returns a failure status on read. Stubbed bus broker captures all publications.
procedure: Configure gps_lib stub to return a non-success JUNO_STATUS_T on its next read.
Reset the bus broker capture buffer.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Inspect the bus broker capture for the structured GPS fix and raw NMEA topics.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Zero structured GPS fix messages and zero raw NMEA messages are published when the gps_lib read fails; only the (unhealthy) health status is published.

test_cases.title: POSIX and Pico2 Builds Produce Identical Bus Messages
test_cases.setup: Compile the gps_app unit test binary in both POSIX and Pico2 host-test configurations against identical stubbed gps_lib, nmea_lib, and bus broker fed with the same canned NMEA byte sequence.
procedure: Build gps_app_test for the POSIX configuration and the Pico2 host-test configuration.
Run each test binary with the same fixed canned NMEA byte sequence as input to the gps_lib stub.
Capture every bus broker publication (topic, payload bytes) from each run into a serialized log.
Diff the POSIX log against the Pico2 host-test log byte-for-byte.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The captured bus publication logs from the POSIX and Pico2 host-test builds are byte-for-byte identical given the same input sequence.

test_cases.title: Published Fix Altitude Field Is HAE (WGS-84)
test_cases.setup: Stubbed nmea_lib returns a parsed fix with altitude tagged as HAE in its output structure. Bus broker captures the structured fix publication.
procedure: Configure nmea_lib stub to return a parsed fix with altitude_hae=A and any geoid separation field populated.
Invoke the gps_app execute hook once.
Capture the structured GPS fix publication from the bus broker.
Inspect the altitude field of the published payload and the schema/typedef of the published message.
Confirm by inspection of the gps_app source that the altitude field assigned to the bus message is the HAE field, not a geoid-referenced (MSL) value.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The altitude field of the published GPS fix message equals A (the HAE value), and the message schema documents the altitude as WGS-84 ellipsoid-referenced.
